## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:unit` passes
- [ ] New/changed methods have unit tests

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-facing changes
